availability_definitions.historically_observed: Dated historical measurement with a retained lawful provenance witness; no such data obtained.
availability_definitions.retrospectively_reconstructable: Surviving original publication records or sampled historical query can conditionally be reconstructed later; not historical real-time availability or completeness.
availability_definitions.current_snapshot_only: Only retrieval-time cumulative/current measure; not a historical monthly view series.
availability_definitions.unavailable: No usable data obtained for this series under tested access, credential and rights conditions; not a global impossibility claim.
availability_definitions.not_tested: No authorized data query or adequate coverage verification performed.

classification_note: availability_class describes this run; potential_class_after_unblocking describes measurement feasibility, NOT obtained coverage or permission. Official URLs with failed requests remain NOT VERIFIED; generated Google reference read via official GitHub is not a terms/quota audit.

sources.authentication: A configured Google project/API key for public Data API reads is the proposed prerequisite; no usable key among checked variable names. Owner analytics requires separate authorization. Getting-started page not readable here.
sources.cost_and_rate_limits: No paid data product proposed. Current quota allocation, method charges, quota-extension conditions and current pricing NOT VERIFIED: canonical quota page blocked. Do not budget an unverified numeric limit.
sources.collection_and_redistribution: Public API metadata is not open-licensed data. Storage/refresh/deletion/redistribution requirements require current developer-policy review before real ingestion. No titles, descriptions, author identifiers or real API records redistributed.
sources.historical_coverage: Candidate reconstruction from publication timestamps of currently accessible videos, potentially including 2018–2025; no actual channel inventory or historical completeness demonstrated. Current surviving inventory cannot recover deleted/private videos.
sources.geographic_and_language_selectivity: Fixed channel ID plus separately coded language/content-country. regionCode/relevanceLanguage and a German channel name do not prove audience in Germany.
sources.timestamp_quality: API snippet.publishedAt is a timezone-stamped publication/upload field; private-to-public transitions and premieres need canonical semantic review. Not a view timestamp.
sources.reproducibility: Freeze channel selection before outcomes, resolve IDs, enumerate upload playlists with all pagination, retain lawful minimal IDs/timestamps and extraction hashes; reruns differ after deletions.
sources.known_biases: Survivorship, selected-channel/topic definitions, sponsored content, reuploads, Shorts format changes, name changes; keyword search is relevance-limited, not an exhaustive historical census.

sources.potential_series: Tesla search-interest index for DE, kept separate
sources.authentication: Public Explore/CSV UI route requires no project key in the proposed manual-export workflow. Actual Explore GET returned 429. API alpha/access conditions NOT VERIFIED because announcement page blocked.
sources.cost_and_rate_limits: Public UI export documented; no paid product required for that route. Rate limit is unspecified and observed 429 is respected. No promise of unrestricted automation.
sources.collection_and_redistribution: Official Help permits export/citation subject to Google Terms. Review terms and attribution for a supplied CSV; no actual Trends data redistributed here.

sources.geographic_and_language_selectivity: geo=DE is a provider country filter for search origin, not citizenship, purchasers or creator audience. Tesla search term is ambiguous with Nikola Tesla; resolve automotive topic separately before use.

sources.reproducibility: Freeze term versus topic ID, geo=DE, category=0, gprop=web, exact window and retrieval; retain export bytes/hash. Repeat lawful exports to quantify sample instability; do not splice independently normalized windows.
sources.known_biases: Sampled search proportions normalized 0–100; low-volume 0 is not zero searches; statistical noise, changing denominators, noncommercial Tesla queries, spikes not purchases.
